zh.title: 云层遮挡规划与天气数据源切换
zh.summary: 新增太阳、月亮和银心云层几何规划，完善天气来源、单位与地图交互。

items.text: 新增云层遮挡规划，支持太阳、月亮、银心与自动目标，提供单层云底及分层云高的自动读取和手动输入。
新增遮蔽云距、地平线云距、擦地云距与最远无云距的球面几何参考，以及地图视线、交点与距离弧线。
新增分钟级时间条、六个天体升落快捷入口、中英文云层图解及云底高度图层选项。
天气表格支持切换 Windy / Open-Meteo 数据源，观测时段与收藏地点对比同步使用所选来源。
统一跟随 Windy 的风速、温度、降水、距离和海拔单位，优化面板高度、方向线及移动端交互。
优化雷达时次匹配与开关交互，处理最新观测的发布延迟，避免将旧雷达帧显示为未来预报。

en.title: Cloud planning and weather source selection
en.summary: Plan cloud geometry for the Sun, Moon and Galactic Center with improved weather sources, units and map interaction.

items.text: Added cloud-obstruction planning for the Sun, Moon, Galactic Center and automatic target selection, with automatic or manual single-layer and layered cloud heights.
Added spherical-geometry references for sightline intersections, horizon distance, grazing distance and far-clear distance, with corresponding map rays, markers and arcs.
Added a minute timeline, six celestial rise/set shortcuts, bilingual cloud diagrams and a cloud-base overlay option.
Added Windy / Open-Meteo weather-source switching, shared by observation windows and favorite-location comparisons.
Follow Windy wind, temperature, precipitation, distance and elevation units, and improve panel sizing, direction lines and mobile interactions.
Improved radar timestamp matching and toggle controls, accounting for observation publication delays without presenting old radar frames as future forecasts.
